hookups.source: https://www.raysvillecampground.com/contact-us ('Each of our campsites have electric and water hook-ups! 15/30/50 AMP') + RMS Cloud categories 'Back In' / 'Pull Through' ('*There are no septic hookup available at this time*'), read 2026-10-29

sites.source: https://www.raysvillecampground.com/ ('The campground features 55 campsites, each equipped with 50/30/15 amp electrical hookups') + RMS Cloud site categories 'Back In' and 'Pull Through' (no lengths in the engine), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: RMS Cloud property description ('Amenities include restrooms, showers, a dump station, boat ramp and dock') + https://www.raysvillecampground.com/ FAQ ('we have a dump station located close to the upper bath house'), read 2026-10-29

season.source: https://www.raysvillecampground.com/ FAQ ('Raysville Campground is open year around for all types of camping'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $30 a night for back-in and pull-through sites, no tax shown; same rate on every 2026 and 2027 date checked. $30 fee on any cancellation.

fees.source: RMS Cloud GetAvailabilityRates ('Nightly Rate' bookingTariff 30, taxAmount 0 for both categories on 2026-11-10, 2026-11-13, 2027-05-11, 2027-07-02, 2027-09-14) + https://www.raysvillecampground.com/campground-rules ('There is a $30.00 cancellation fee on ALL cancellations'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Book online (RMS Cloud) or call 706-595-6759; paid in full before setting up. The engine's footer still links a dead JackRabbit page.

booking.source: https://www.raysvillecampground.com/ ('Book Now' -> RMS Cloud; FAQ 'We allow you to book 12 months from the current date', 'We allow each camper to book up to 30 days before having to leave') + /contact-us ('For Reservations Book Online or Call Us Today (706) 595-6759') + /campground-rules ('All reservations must be paid in FULL before setting up'; 'The maximum number of days that any camper may stay is 30 days continuous'), read 2026-10-29

note: McDuffie County-operated (formerly USACE) campground on the Little River arm of Clarks Hill / J. Strom Thurmond Lake, ~9 mi from Thomson; sites run along wooded peninsulas. Boat ramp and dock; kayak and paddle-board rentals. Gates open at all times. --Claude
summary: County site + its RMS Cloud engine: 55 sites with water and 15/30/50 A electric, no sewer (dump station), back-in and pull-through types, showers, $30 a night every 2026/2027 date checked, online booking 12 months out, 30-night max, open year-round. Phone was missing - 706-595-6759 (county site and Google, 4.5 stars / 116 reviews). Lakefront not vetoed: imagery shows the site loops on narrow wooded peninsulas in the lake, pads ~20-40 m from the shore; the engine calls it 'situated in a wooded area on the waterfront'.
flags: Phone missing: the campground's reservation phone is 706-595-6759 (raysvillecampground.com/contact-us and Google Maps). The camp host is 706-699-6257.

Pin ~1.05 km east of the campground (stored 33.6335,-82.4675 sits across GA-43 from the site loops). The booking engine's per-site map (49 numbered sites) centres on 33.63367,-82.47883; Google's 33.63231,-82.47408 is the entrance on Lincolnton Rd. Suggest 33.6337,-82.4788.
